items.note: Nova Scotia repealed its fixed-date law in 2025. The five-year constitutional limit means an election by about November 2029, and it can be called any time before.

items.title: Ontario general election
items.note: Ontario ended fixed election dates in 2025. The five-year constitutional limit from the February 27, 2025 election means a vote by early 2030, and the Premier can call it any time before.
